free_tier.stated: Advertised as no cap: 'No episode caps, no storage limits, no upcharging as your show grows. Unlimited hosting, included in every plan', plus 'Up to 5 shows for free'. No numeric storage or per-file figure is published anywhere in their docs — the pricing comparison table exposes rows only as 'Unlimited' with no labels in the extracted DOM.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Not metered in any published doc; hosting and publishing show 'Unlimited' in the plan comparison.

tooling: No public upload API found; dashboard upload only. RSS out is standard.
chaining: 5 shows per free account x unlimited episodes x unpublished per-file cap. Multiple accounts = 5 shows each.
limits_note: Per-episode file size is NOT published — this is the risk. Zencastr also sells a recording product whose free tier is separately capped at '2 hours of audio and video recording per month' with 'Recording masters storage of up to 31 days' (2023 change), which is easy to confuse with hosting; hosting is the uncapped part, recording masters are not.
